name: Data Pipeline Contract & Schema Drift Validator
description: Verifies data stream contracts (JSON Schema, Avro, Parquet schemas) for breaking mutations, nullability changes, precision loss, and backwards/forwards schema compatibility.

producerSchema.description: JSON Schema or Avro schema string of the producer event.

consumerExpectedSchema.description: Schema expected by downstream consumer pipelines.

allowAdditiveChanges.description: Whether optional new fields are allowed without breaking the contract.
